description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Printer, which provides methods for rendering HTML elements, generating HTML tags, escaping strings, and retrieving class metadata, as part of the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering HTML elements, generating tags, escaping strings, and retrieving class metadata within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for HTMLPurifier_Printer, currently does nothing.
